name: Žďár nad Sázavou (Czechia)
description: Divided per saltire into yellow upper and lower triangles and red hoist and fly triangles, with two crossed black knotted branches.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 26 April 1996 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
